Research is bought at the building it belongs to: a class's at its guild, faith's at the temple, trade's at the market, knowledge at the library and a castle path's at the path's own buildings. The level is that of the best such building standing. It is paid for once and kept for the whole game, also when the building falls.

## Research Tips

:::tip[Priority Order]
1. **Potion Mastery** (200g) -- Low cost, high value; greatly improves Warrior survivability
2. **Arcane Affinity** (200g) -- Noticeable boost to Mage attack power
3. **Treasure Sense** (350g) -- Benefits all classes, increases gold income
4. Choose subsequent skills based on your primary class composition
:::

:::note[All-Class Skills]
Skills marked as "All Classes" apply to **every** adventurer and typically offer the best value for their cost.
:::
